about: Synthesised replay traces: per turn, counts drawn uniformly from each range with the shape's seed. No text: the replay takes its words from the document set at run time.

agent-60.words: an agent session: 60 turns, each a short request with 800 to 2,400 tokens of tool output and a 200 to 800 token reply, after a 3,000-token system prompt

chat-300.words: a chat session shaped like GameTerm's: 300 turns of 20 to 400 new tokens and a 50 to 200 token reply, after a 3,000-token system prompt
